points.title: 早年生活
points.description: 玛雅·安吉罗在圣路易斯出生，并在那里度过了她的童年。她的早年生活充满了贫困和种族歧视，这些经历后来成为她文学创作的重要灵感来源。她在12岁时被迫离开学校，开始了她作为性工作者的生活，这段经历对她的成长和写作产生了深远的影响。
points.descriptionEn: Maya Angelou was born in St. Louis, Missouri, and spent her childhood there. Her early life was marked by poverty and racial discrimination, experiences that would later become significant sources of inspiration for her literary work. At the age of 12, she was forced to leave school and began a life as a sex worker, an experience that profoundly impacted her growth and writing.

points.title: 文学起步
points.description: 安吉罗在纽约市开始了她的文学生涯，她开始写作并发表诗歌。她的第一本诗集《咖啡屋的夜晚》于1951年出版，这是她文学道路上的重要一步。在纽约，她结识了许多作家和艺术家，这对她的创作产生了积极影响。
points.descriptionEn: Maya Angelou began her literary career in New York City, where she started writing and publishing poetry. Her first poetry collection, 'Coffeehouse Nights,' was published in 1951, marking an important step in her literary journey. In New York, she met many writers and artists, which had a positive impact on her work.

points.title: 非洲之旅
points.description: 安吉罗在1961年前往非洲，这是她人生中的一个转折点。她在加纳度过了几个月，这段经历让她更加深刻地理解了她的非洲根源，并激发了她对种族平等和社会正义的承诺。她在非洲的经历也影响了她的写作，特别是她的自传《我知道为什么风在吹》。
points.descriptionEn: In 1961, Maya Angelou traveled to Africa, which was a turning point in her life. She spent several months in Ghana, a period that deepened her understanding of her African roots and ignited her commitment to racial equality and social justice. Her experiences in Africa also influenced her writing, particularly her autobiography 'I Know Why the Caged Bird Sings'.

points.title: 文学成就
points.description: 安吉罗在纽约市继续她的文学创作，她的作品开始受到更广泛的认可。她的自传《我知道为什么风在吹》获得了巨大成功，并赢得了普利策奖。此外，她还发表了多部诗集和小说，成为美国文学界的重要人物。
points.descriptionEn: Maya Angelou continued her literary work in New York City, and her works began to receive wider recognition. Her autobiography 'I Know Why the Caged Bird Sings' achieved great success and won the Pulitzer Prize. She also published numerous poetry collections and novels, becoming an important figure in American literature.

points.title: 公众演讲与倡导
points.description: 安吉罗成为了一位著名的公众演讲者和倡导者，她在全国各地发表演讲，倡导种族平等和社会正义。她的演讲和写作继续激励着人们，并对美国的文化和社会产生了深远的影响。
points.descriptionEn: Maya Angelou became a renowned public speaker and advocate, traveling across the United States to deliver speeches advocating for racial equality and social justice. Her speeches and writings continued to inspire people and had a profound impact on American culture and society.

supporter.zh: 玛雅·安吉罗被视为美国文学和文化的瑰宝，她的作品深刻地揭示了种族、性别和社会不平等的问题。她的自传和诗歌激励了无数人，她的勇气和智慧被广泛地赞美。
supporter.en: Maya Angelou is regarded as a treasure of American literature and culture, whose works deeply reveal issues of racial, gender, and social inequality. Her autobiographies and poetry have inspired countless people, and her courage and wisdom are widely praised.

critic.zh: 一些批评者认为，安吉罗的作品有时过于个人化，缺乏更广泛的社会和历史背景。此外，她的某些政治立场也受到了争议。
critic.en: Some critics argue that Angelou's works are sometimes too personalized, lacking broader social and historical context. Additionally, her political stances have also been controversial.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和大众文化中，玛雅·安吉罗被定义为一位重要的美国作家和人权倡导者。她的作品和演讲对推动种族平等和社会正义产生了深远的影响，她的遗产将继续激励着未来的世代。
objective.en: In the academic and popular cultural spheres, Maya Angelou is defined as an important American writer and civil rights advocate. Her works and speeches have had a profound impact on promoting racial equality and social justice, and her legacy will continue to inspire future generations.

self.zh: 人们总是问我，‘你是谁？’我总是回答，‘我是我。’
self.en: People always ask me, 'Who are you?' And I always answer, 'I am me.'

others.zh: 玛雅·安吉罗是一位真正的诗人，她的作品充满了力量和智慧。
others.en: Maya Angelou is a true poet, whose work is filled with power and wisdom.
